Landed as Gerrit 3438, merge commit 705b495a59090f041c12e026251f6747715c6605, with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
- The regression test failed on the old helper (1 failed, 5 passed) and passes on the new one. The test_model_classes.py file passed 3 runs in a row.
- `make verify`: 21,411 passed and 226 integration tests passed, 0 failed.
- After the merge, Gerrit 3431 PS2 (veery) went Verified +1. Its PS1 had failed on this race.
- Post-merge sweep run 44448117626 on 705b495a590 was dispatched to check the GIL `sweep (py3.14)` leg, which had failed on the pre-fix commit 0e41265e6a0 (job 135294924673).
